assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are provisional constraints because official polygons are not included in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All area, control, and implementation statements remain conceptual and must be recalculated when official files arrive.

assumptions.statement: No resident identity, face, voice, precise movement trace, or sensitive data is required for the proposed civic services.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards specify anonymous aggregation, human assistance, offline alternatives, and a stop/appeal path.

assumptions.statement: Ownership, utilities, road redlines, heritage controls, budgets, operators, and approvals are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Renewal projects are reference schemes only; no demolition, procurement, construction, or operating commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: The Beijing Municipal Cultural Heritage Bureau publishes textual protection and construction-control offsets for the former Qinghuayuan Station, but no georeferenced official control polygon is included in this submission package.
assumptions.impact: No landmark, new structure, excavation, equipment or event infrastructure is assigned a fixed location near the station. A heritage-led no-build screening must precede any siting decision.

assumptions.statement: The 2025 public notice records consultation responses to a draft street-level regulatory plan; it is not treated as an approved statutory plan or reusable redline dataset.
assumptions.impact: Road junctions, setbacks, land-use controls and implementation interfaces remain conceptual until the approved plan and official GIS are supplied.

assumptions.statement: District-wide population, laboratory and registered-model totals are official context figures and cannot be downscaled to the provisional design boundary without a valid allocation method.
assumptions.impact: These values support the need for inclusive talent, testing and public-service interfaces but are not used to size buildings, forecast users or claim project performance.

assumptions.statement: The official web pages added in this revision do not display an explicit open-reuse licence on the retrieved landing pages, except where a source record states otherwise.
assumptions.impact: The package uses short factual paraphrases and links only; it does not copy source photographs, maps, logos or interface assets.

assumptions.statement: The 2026 official Qinghe Station area diagram is a schematic axonometric relationship, not a surveyed, architectural, fire-safety or operating plan.
assumptions.impact: It supports 2F/1F/B1/B2 functional relationships and the existence of underpass, corridor and accessible-lift elements, but no dimension, level, coordinate, exact entrance or turn-by-turn route.

assumptions.statement: Official 2025-2026 pages confirm accessibility-review elements and real human assistance/handoff cases at Qinghe Station, but do not establish a permanent post, staffing schedule or standard service capacity.
assumptions.impact: The proposal may demonstrate a human-handoff service principle but cannot promise where or when staff will be present. A missing staff point ends in an honest stop, not an AI substitute.

assumptions.statement: The exact boundary among municipal public passage, station-area management, rail/metro security and other controlled space is not available in a reusable official base.
assumptions.impact: All Qinghe components remain outside fare/security control in an NTS relationship. No installation, access or responsibility transfer is treated as authorised.

assumptions.statement: No authorised survey, architectural base or field measurement is available for the selected Qinghe public interface.
assumptions.impact: The prototype remains permanently NTS unless an authorised base or documented survey later exists. It does not progress to 1:200 or 1:100 by visual estimation.
